title: Exact Diameter Windows for Random Cayley Graphs on Odd-Order Abelian Groups
summary: Let \(d\ge2\) be fixed and let \(G_n\) be finite abelian groups of odd orders \(N_n\to\infty\). We determine the centered diameter-\(d\) critical window for the standard random Cayley graph in which each nonzero group element is selected independently. Writing \(M_n=(N_n-1)/2\), we prove that the normalized first distance-\(d\) coverage times satisfy \sum_{[x]\in(G_n\setminus\{0\})/\{\pm1\}} δ_{\frac{N_n^{d-1}}{d!}τ_{n,[x]}^d-\log M_n} \xrightarrow{d} \PPP(e^{-z} $\,dz).
